rules.rationale: The homepage identifies graduate funding and teaching assistantships as opportunities distinct from program requirements.
Safety procedures, stores and graduate resources provide practical support.
The research section describes the department's materials research areas.
The homepage explicitly labels its undergraduate research feature as a spotlight/story and links the corresponding story category.
News and events sections and dated departmental posts report announcements and updates, except the explicitly identified story above.

fallback.rationale: The department's primary public purpose is materials engineering education, including undergraduate and graduate programs, courses and academic community information.
